title: Stand Users Anonymous Server Pack
description: Made for a server with small group of friends. Based on the Sensible MC modpack, the goal is to keep the experience close to vanilla, but to re-balance certain aspects to make it more enjoyable as well as adding cosmetics and decoration for flavoring.
body:
This modpack is designed to enhance the vanilla experience with a few deviations that make it easier to play. It is made for use on a small personal minecraft server.

The base of this modpack comes from the ["Sensible MC official" Modpack](https://modrinth.com/modpack/sensible-modpack) by [Stackleyy on youtube](https://www.youtube.com/@Stackleyy). Several of the mods that feel outside of the Vanilla+ scope of this server have been removed, and a couple new ones have been added.

The goal is to keep the experience close to vanilla, but to rebalance certain aspects to make it more enjoyable as well as adding cosmetics and decoration for flavoring.

Included are many texture packs and cosmetic mods such as (Bee's) Fancy Crops, 3D Ladders, Armor Reimagined, Falling Leaves, and Mossy's Better Dirt; client side mods such as AppleSkin, Client Tweaks, MiniHUD, Jade, Just Zoom, Light Level Overlay, and Roughly Enough Items; server side mods like Inventory Totem, Server Day Counter, Better Safe Bed, Comfortable Campfires, Drop Spread 2, and PetProtect; and mods needed on both such as Nicer Portals, [Let's Do] Furniture, Ammendments, Easy Magic, Magic Mirror, and Tom's Simple Storage.
